text:
zoe_fin: Heads up — Partner FluxLayer flagged a discrepancy after our April pricing experiment. They say we passed through a temporary promo rate to end-customers but didn't reduce their reseller payable.

ren_billing: can you paste the example line they sent?

caleb_partners: they pasted this from portal: `partner_id=flux-01, invoice=FL-APR-26-12, sku=redwood-inference.standard, units=50, promo_tag=apr-promo-10pct, customer_billed=45/unit, partner_settlement=50/unit` They expected partner_settlement to be 45/unit.

ingest-bot: deploy: pricing-service v1.8.0 rolled out 2026-04-12T04:00:01Z.

ren_billing: looks like the pricing experiment injected a customer-facing discount but our reseller settlement logic uses the base_rate unless the promo is marked as "reseller_visible". Experiment was customer-only.

zoe_fin: what's the dollar impact?

ren_billing: base_rate=$300/unit, customer_billed=$270/unit (10% promo). Partner settlement expected $270 but ledger used $300. Delta per unit = $30. 50 units -> $1,500.

maya_treasury: pre-approve a provisional adjustment/credit of $1,500 pending partner confirmation.

caleb_partners: partner asks for an explanation and wants the settlement updated. They do not want a credit note; they want the invoice recalculated so their payable matches customer net.

zoe_fin: options: (A) issue a one-off credit $1,500, (B) re-run settlement calculation for that partner and reissue invoice (preferred by partner), (C) change pricing experiment flags to mark promos as affecting reseller if partner opted in.

ren_billing: technical note: re-running settlement requires regenerating the reseller_payable CSV and re-importing before month-end close. That's doable but we need deploy windows for safe backfill. Also need partner consent to modify issued invoice.

caleb_partners: partner consents to reissue. They prefer corrected invoice instead of separate credit.

zoe_fin: ok let's re-run settlement for FluxLayer for Apr 130, produce corrected invoice FL-APR-26-12-rev1, update GLs accordingly. Also flag pricing experiments so customer-only promos are explicit and send partner opt-in checklist for future promos.

ren_billing: will run recalculation and create revised ledger file. backfill id s3://redwood-billing/reconciliations/2026-04-fluxlayer-recalc.csv. Import id imp-2026-04-13-3312.

maya_treasury: schedule payment adjustment and mark original invoice void; approve reissued invoice for partner payout.

caleb_partners: notified FluxLayer and attached revised invoice PDF. They acknowledged and will proceed with their records.

zoe_fin: RCA: pricing experiment customer-only discounts were applied to customer charges but settlement logic defaulted to base_rate. Remediation: (1) settle FluxLayer corrected invoice (-$1,500), (2) add experiment flag "affects_reseller" and default false, require partner opt-in for promos that change settlement, (3) add integration test to ensure promo flow updates reseller settlement when flag enabled, (4) create partner communication playbook.

ren_billing: implementing the flag and tests; will include monitoring to detect settlement vs billing divergence > $100.

maya_treasury: approved. Close FIN ticket after updated invoice posts and AP confirms.

zoe_fin: thanks team. leaving thread open until AP posts payment change.
